children.value: > Fact From Story: United have also conceded 14 goals in the Champions League group stages, a new and unwanted record for the club that could get worse when they face Bayern in the final match.
> > Fact From Story: United have also conceded 14 goals in the Champions League group stages, a new and unwanted record for the club that could get worse when they face Bayern in the final match.

> > > Fact From Story: United now have to beat Bayern Munich and hope Galatasaray draw with FC Copenhagen on the final matchday to progress, and it's the third time in the Champions League this season that they have been in a winning position and then failed to emerge victorious.
> > > Fact From Story: Eight points have been dropped when they've been in the lead, and no other team has suffered a worse fate this term.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Failing to win games is a sign of struggling.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Conceding goals makes it harder to win games.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A team that concedes many goals in a competition is struggling.
